occurrences.text: And about the eleventh hour he went out, and found others standing idle, and saith unto them, Why stand ye here all the day idle?
And when they came that were hired about the eleventh hour, they received every man a penny.
The fifth, sardonyx; the sixth, sardius; the seventh, chrysolite; the eighth, beryl; the ninth, a topaz; the tenth, a chrysoprasus; the eleventh, a jacinth; the twelfth, an amethyst.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
